title: fix(spec): the ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused migration text names the promoted field-backed bulk route
body:
Fixes #22858
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Text only, in one file: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts`, the major-18 D3 entry that `objectstack migrate meta` prints. Two clauses said the bulk surface has no field-backed param route. Since objectui `29b99490` (an ancestor of the console pin), a PROMOTED bulk action resolves its field-backed params through the single-record dialog's resolver. Both clauses now say that the AUTHORED `bulkActionDefs[].params` surface has no such route, name the promoted route, and name its two keys (`accept` / `maxSize` arrive from the field). The wording follows what `581ca7d4e4` landed in `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`: the module comment at `:151`-`:170`, the `field` guidance at `:211`-`:221`, and the widget-config prescription at `:252`-`:267`.

Plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`. No regeneration commit: `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` and the upgrade guide are git-ignored. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` is not touched; it is release-owned.

### Before and after (evaluated strings, clause by clause; every other clause is byte-identical)

**`replacement`, before:**

> the keys that belong one layer out are pointed there (`visible` and a capability gate belong on the DEF, `visibleWhen` belongs on an `options[]` entry, `field` / `objectOverride` / `carryOver` / `defaultFromRow` / `requiresFeature` are field-backed ACTION-param contracts the bulk surface does not implement); and the widget-config family (…) is answered with one prescription naming `FieldSchema` as the shape those keys are real on.

**`replacement`, after:**

> the keys that belong one layer out are pointed there (`visible` and a capability gate belong on the DEF, `visibleWhen` belongs on an `options[]` entry, `carryOver` / `defaultFromRow` / `requiresFeature` are ACTION-param contracts the bulk surface does not implement); `field` / `objectOverride` declare a FIELD-BACKED param, and an authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` entry has no such route — it reaches the dialog as written, and nothing on that path resolves it against the object's field definitions — so the `field` rejection offers two fixes: declare the param inline, or declare the action on the object with that field-backed param and name it in the view's `bulkActions`, the PROMOTED route, whose params are resolved through the single-record dialog's resolver when the bulk dialog opens; and the widget-config family (…) is answered with one prescription naming `FieldSchema` as the shape those keys are real on, and saying that of them only `accept` / `maxSize` declared there reach this dialog, through a promoted action.

**`reason`, before:**

> ⛔ Do not read their rejection as "the renderer ignores them", and ⛔ do not answer it by declaring the key on the object's FIELD: the bulk surface has no field-backed param route, so that value does not reach this dialog either.

**`reason`, after:**

> ⛔ Do not read their rejection as "the renderer ignores them", and ⛔ do not answer it by declaring the key on the object's FIELD and keeping the authored def: an authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` entry has no field-backed param route, so that value does not reach this dialog either. The one route that consults the field is a PROMOTED action — an action the object declares, named in the view's `bulkActions`, whose field-backed params (`{ field }`) are resolved through the single-record dialog's resolver when the bulk dialog opens — and of these keys only `accept` / `maxSize` arrive that way: `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` are resolved and then dropped on the bulk path, and the rest are never read off the field.

The diff also re-wraps two string-concatenation lines with no byte change to the evaluated text. That was proved by evaluating `entry` at the base `75b6d6a048` and at this head, splitting each field at clause boundaries, and diffing: only the clauses quoted above differ, and `surface` / `acceptanceCriteria` are identical.

## The claim, verified at the console pin

`.objectui-sha` at the base is `4997995022` (the card was filed against `0df67f237c`; the pin has moved since). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 29b99490 4997995022` exits 0, which is self-proving even in a shallow checkout. All readings use `git show 4997995022:…` in objectui:

- **The promoted route resolves field-backed params.** `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:5174`-`:5183`: `resolveDialogParams` calls `resolvePromotedBulkParams(def, { objectName, objects, fieldLabel, fieldOptionLabel, locale })` when the dialog opens, for a def carrying `actionDef` (a promoted one). `packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts:197`-`:212`: that function passes the action's params to `resolveActionParams` from `@object-ui/fields`, the single-record dialog's resolver, then maps each result through `toBulkParam`.
- **`accept` / `maxSize` arrive.** `packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:781`-`:782` (field-backed branch): `accept: param.accept ?? field.accept`, `maxSize: param.maxSize ?? field.maxSize`. `resolveBulkActions.ts:172`-`:173`: `toBulkParam` forwards both. `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkParamToField.ts:163`, `:167`: the `...extra` spread carries them onto the widget's field bag.
- **`lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` are resolved, then dropped.** `resolveActionParams.ts:757`, `:759`-`:761` resolve them (with the snake `id_field` read at `:756`). `toBulkParam` (`resolveBulkActions.ts:159`-`:175`) emits none of them; its docblock at `:146`-`:149` says so.
- **The rest are never read.** The field-backed return (`resolveActionParams.ts:766`-`:784`, with the lookup extras at `:754`-`:762`) reads no `min`, `max`, `step`, `precision`, `scale`, `rows`, `crop`, `capture`, `dimensions`, `defaultName`, `allowCreate`, `picker`, `subtitle` or `avatarField` off the field.
- **`carryOver` / `defaultFromRow` / `requiresFeature` stay unimplemented on the promoted route too,** which is why the replacement keeps that clause. `toBulkParam` forwards neither `carryOver` nor `visible` (the target that `requiresFeature` is lowered into), and the resolver context at `ObjectGrid.tsx:5177`-`:5183` passes no `row`, so `defaultFromRow` has nothing to read.

`STEP18_RATIONALE` in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` carries no fragment for this entry: the sorted list goes from `ui-ai-chat-window-retired` (`:2747`) to `ui-form-layout-inline-grid-retired` (`:2762`), and the template has zero `field-backed` hits. So nothing moves there.

The new text carries no tracker id. `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` refuses a hash sign followed by four or five digits in the printed block.

## Acceptance notes

- **`acceptanceCriteria` is left untouched, as ruled.** Its closing sentence still says that where a widget-config key's behaviour is gone, "the remedy is a spec issue asking for the key, not a local workaround". For `accept` / `maxSize` there is now a second remedy: the landed prescription's "for `accept` / `maxSize` move the param onto a promoted action". The `reason` clause printed just above it now states that remedy, so the printed block is not wrong, only incomplete in its last sentence. Whether to align that sentence is a call for the reviewing seat. Carrier: the seat reviewing this PR. Noted here; no card is filed.
